cases.name: managed implementation host outlives its original client process and reconnects to the same approval, checks, review, apply and undo
managed implementation host serializes concurrent windows, rejects stale approval/cancel requests, and cancels through a new connection
managed implementation host refuses unauthenticated clients and restores a dead host as interrupted without repeating inference
managed implementation host does not launch a replacement when an occupied endpoint fails to answer authentication

caveat: The full run failed one original-client launch. The child had a 30-second exec timeout and the approval record appeared about 29 seconds after job start. This suggests startup timing but the original error did not record killed/signal, so the cause is not proved. The isolated four-case rerun passed without changing limits. The failed fixture was cancelled through its exact managed-job connection; no process was killed by a broad name or PID guess. Native Webview pointer delivery is not covered.
